/* BmsTotalManageMapper.selectCjDeliveryListExcel : CJ 택배 Excel 조회 */ WITH LastStatus AS ( SELECT PACKING_NO, APPROVAL_CLASS, REGISTER_DATE_TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PACKING_NO ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC) AS RN FROM TB_BMS_OUT_DELIVERY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE DELIVERY_CODE = #{srchDeliveryTypeGbn} AND FORMAT(CAST(REGISTER_DATE_TIME AS DATETIME), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{srchDeliveryDate} ), Valid AS ( SELECT PACKING_NO, REGISTER_DATE_TIME FROM LastStatus WHERE RN = 1 AND APPROVAL_CLASS = '31' ) SELECT PACKING_NO AS packingNo FROM Valid ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE_TIME
